sdk_source_and_operation_rows.operations: Axis products with sine and one-minus-cosine form a rotation matrix before the combine-mode dispatch.
Combine modes scale components versus basis vectors, or construct the replacement diagonal.
Combine modes add translation directly, multiply it by the basis, or set identity and translation.
Combine modes swap the matrix-product operands or copy the replacement matrix.
Modes 1 and 2 store projection, conditionally update the frame and update depth. An invalid mode reports an error and returns null.
Two operand orders in both rotate and transform call the same affine product. The callee combines four vector rows and intersects input flags.
Projection updates its parent frame. The callee links a clean root into the dirty list and sets root and subtree flags.
Projection changes recompute the two depth coefficients from near and far planes using reciprocal depth in perspective mode.
The device callback runs first. Six fallback requests select count, name, current and selected subsystem or finalization defaults.

0diax/diax-mkarmageddon.video_setup: Function 002695f0 calls 002a37cb (catalogued as XGetVideoFlags). Flag 0x02 takes precedence and writes 1280x720. Otherwise flag 0x01 writes 720x480. ps2_admissions.operations: Requires a 12-byte read. Decodes the old and packed library IDs and conditionally stores type, length, version and build. The retail build output extends the 3.1 reference ABI.
Reads headers, skips the payload of each nonmatching type, then repeats. A matching type requires an unsigned version from 0x34000 through 0x36003 before length and version are returned.
Finds the extension chunk (type 3), dispatches nested chunks by registered ID or skips their payloads, subtracts each payload plus 12 bytes, then invokes registered always callbacks.
Stores both window components and their reciprocals, updates a non-null parent frame through 001a7510, and returns the camera on both branches.

ps2_stream_version.header_reader: 0019f0b0 reads 12 bytes. A zero upper half of the library ID selects the old version-shift-by-eight form with build zero. In the packed form the low halfword supplies the build. The original code decodes the observed 0x1803ffff stamp to 0x36003 and 0xffff.
ps2_stream_version.finder: 0019f1e0 admits matching-type headers with 0x34000 <= version < 0x36004. The branch-likely delay slot at 0019f244 initializes the upper limit. The finder skips unmatched payloads and rereads the header.
ps2_stream_version.registry: At 001a2bec the registry reader asks for chunk type 3. Its success-only delay slot at 001a2bf8 loads the returned version. It repeats the unsigned compatibility check, performs registered callbacks or skips payloads, and finally calls each configured always callback.
ps2_stream_version.limits: These static comparisons establish an accepted version range. They cannot determine the exact PS2 linked runtime revision, toolchain or ownership of all remaining functions.
